mapper.select: SELECT o.reg_user_id AS "userId",h.hist_sn::int AS "historySn" FROM tb_sl_opp o JOIN tb_sl_aprv_hist h ON h.opp_id=o.opp_id WHERE o.opp_id=#{opportunityId} AND h.aprv_act_cd='REJ' ORDER BY h.hist_sn DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT reg_user_id AS "userId",scrn_id AS "screenId" FROM tb_sy_upld WHERE upld_id=#{uploadId} AND upld_stat_cd='APPLIED'
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM tb_sy_menu WHERE scrn_id=#{screenId})
SELECT user_id AS "userId",user_nm AS "name",NULLIF(trim(email_addr),'') AS "emailAddress",'' AS "role" FROM tb_sy_user WHERE user_stat_cd='USE' ORDER BY user_id

SELECT u.user_id AS "userId", u.user_nm AS "name", NULLIF(trim(u.email_addr),'') AS "emailAddress", r.role_id AS "role" FROM tb_sy_user u JOIN tb_sy_user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.user_id JOIN tb_sy_role r ON r.role_id=ur.role_id WHERE u.user_stat_cd='USE' AND r.use_yn='Y' AND r.role_id IN ('ADMIN','EXEC','FIN','SALES_LDR','PM') ORDER BY u.user_id,r.role_id

SELECT s.user_id AS "userId",s.scope_type_cd AS "type",s.part_id AS "partId",s.proj_id AS "projectId" FROM tb_sy_user_scope s JOIN tb_sy_user u ON u.user_id=s.user_id WHERE u.user_stat_cd='USE' ORDER BY s.user_id,s.scope_sn
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_sy_delivery_task (task_id,event_key,rcvr_user_id,rcvr_nm,channel_cd,state_cd,noti_type_cd,noti_cn, link_scrn_id,link_key,bill_id,dun_step,dun_sn,resend_yn,sent_dttm,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) VALUES (CAST(#{taskId,typeHandler=com.sicost.common.notifications.NotificationTaskUuidTypeHandler} AS uuid),#{event.key},#{recipient.userId},#{recipient.name},'SYS','SENT',#{event.type},#{event.content}, #{event.link.screenId},#{event.link.key},#{event.dunning.billId},#{event.dunning.step},#{event.dunning.serial}, 'Y''N',#{at},'SYSTEM',#{at}) ON CONFLICT (event_key,rcvr_user_id,channel_cd) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO tb_sy_delivery_task (task_id,event_key,rcvr_user_id,rcvr_nm,channel_cd,state_cd,noti_type_cd,noti_cn,bill_id,dun_step,dun_sn,resend_yn,error_cd,error_cn,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) VALUES (CAST(#{taskId,typeHandler=com.sicost.common.notifications.NotificationTaskUuidTypeHandler} AS uuid),#{event.key},#{recipient.userId},#{recipient.name},'SYS','SKIPPED',#{event.type},'PERMISSION_REVOKED', #{event.dunning.billId},#{event.dunning.step},#{event.dunning.serial}, 'Y''N', 'PERMISSION_REVOKED',#{event.content},'SYSTEM',#{at}) ON CONFLICT (event_key,rcvr_user_id,channel_cd) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: INSERT INTO tb_sy_noti (rcvr_user_id,noti_type_cd,noti_cn,link_scrn_id,link_key,send_mthd_cd,read_yn,read_dttm,noti_dttm,reg_user_id,reg_dttm) VALUES (#{recipient.userId},#{event.type},#{event.content},#{event.link.screenId},#{event.link.key}, 'BOTH''SYS','N',NULL,#{at},'SYSTEM',#{at}) RETURNING noti_id
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_sy_delivery_task SET noti_id=#{notificationId} WHERE task_id=CAST(#{taskId,typeHandler=com.sicost.common.notifications.NotificationTaskUuidTypeHandler} AS uuid)
